<h2 class="intro-title fw-b" id="ctl00_plcMain_plcZones_lt_zoneMain_Intro_introTitle">Newport Group helps companies offer their employees a more secure financial future</h2>
<p class="intro-content" id="ctl00_plcMain_plcZones_lt_zoneMain_Intro_introContent">We are a leading provider of retirement plans, insurance and consulting services—with more than <a href="http://www.newportgroup.com/about/#infographic" target="_blank">$250 billion of corporate retirement and insurance assets, encompassing over one million plan participants from coast to coast</a>. We are committed to meeting the evolving needs of our advisors and plan sponsors while adhering to our most important attributes. <br/>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>
